heldout.holdout: whole domains excluded from train (R-2.6 / R-8.8)

conversational.holdout: row-level holdout from a register the model trains on; in-domain, not comparable to the held-out domains

excluded.why: evaluate.py keys predictions by source string, so a repeated input would reuse one prediction against two references

sampleNote: a 2,000-row stratified sample of the 40,592-row test split, not the full split; both directions are drawn from the same underlying pairs so the per-direction scores are directly comparable
